pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are characterized by complex, multi-lobed polygonal geometries with sharp, high-frequency angular edge gradients and deep invaginations of the surrounding negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways. Features a high density of junction nodes with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the mid-flank, maintaining overall network continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged 1D profile against the background, extending from the visible upper neck to the shoulder ridge with consistent vertical hair density.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Large, diffuse area of dark textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation on the upper flank, resulting in a localized loss of distinct patch-corridor definition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Discrete, dark circular lesion with irregular margins located on the central-lateral flank, distinct from the surrounding pelage pattern.
